name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_coronary_arteriosclerosis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of coronary arteriosclerosis (coronary artery disease).

when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of coronary arteriosclerosis (coronary artery disease).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of coronary arteriosclerosis (coronary artery disease).

when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis is verified by angiography.
